'''Tessa Pardax''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Commodore/Legends|commodore]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Onslaught" />

==Personality and traits==
Pardax was meticulous, calculating, and driven. She was particularly stern with her subordinates. She believed in pure meritocracy, often ignoring or outright refusing commands from powerful [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] she deemed incompetent, which held back her career in the Empire.<ref name="Onslaught" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commodore Pardax first appears as an Alliance Specialist if the [[Alliance Commander|player character]] is an Imperial in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'', joining the Alliance after [[Bey'wan Aygo]]'s retirement to replace him.<ref name="Onslaught" />
